tables.title: Past Perfect Tense (الماضي التام)
rows: The passengers hadn't received their lifeboat numbers.
tables.explanation: نستخدم Past Perfect عندما نريد أن نوضح أي حدثين في الماضي وقع أولاً. الحدث الأقدم (الأول) = Past Perfect (had + past participle)، والحدث الأحدث (الثاني) = Past Simple. الكلمات الدالة: before, after, when, by the time, already, just, never, ever.
tables.examples:
The ship had received 6 warnings when it struck the iceberg.
When I arrived home, my son had already made a cake.
The Titanic was the largest ship that had ever travelled on the sea.
Some survivors had been in the icy water for hours when they were saved.
The passengers hadn't received their lifeboat numbers before the accident.
I had never seen snow until I went to Canada.
She had already left when I arrived.
After the guests had left, I went to bed.

tables.title: Past Simple vs Past Perfect
rows: My son had already made a cake.
The teacher had already given a test.
tables.explanation: Past Simple: للحدث الذي وقع وانتهى في الماضي (الحدث الثاني). Past Perfect: للحدث الذي وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي (الحدث الأول). القاعدة: الحدث الأقدم = Past Perfect / الحدث الأحدث = Past Simple.
tables.examples:
When I arrived home, my son had already made a cake.
The ship had received 6 warnings when it struck the iceberg.
By the time mom came, I had prepared dinner.

tables.title: Past Simple Passive (الماضي البسيط المبني للمجهول)
tables.explanation: نستخدم المبني للمجهول عندما يكون الفاعل غير معروف أو غير مهم. التركيب: was/were + past participle (التصريف الثالث).
tables.examples:
Selak was ejected from the car.
The cake was baked by the chef.
A new house was built by the workers.

tables.title: Comparatives & Superlatives
rows: The Titanic was larger than other ships.
the + adjective + est / the most + adjective
The Titanic was the largest ship.
tables.explanation: للمقارنة بين أكثر من شيئين نستخدم 'the' + صفة + est (للصفات القصيرة) أو 'the most' + صفة (للصفات الطويلة).
tables.examples: The Titanic was the largest ship that had ever travelled on the sea.

tables.title: Prepositions (حروف الجر)
rows: in 1912, in danger, in the water
on its first trip, on the sea, on the radio
late at night, at that time
for hours, for half the people
the number of lifeboats, the edge of death
tables.explanation: حروف الجر تأتي قبل الاسم أو الضمير ولها استخدامات متعددة حسب السياق.
tables.examples:
The ship hit the iceberg late at night.
They had been in the icy water for hours.
They had followed an old rule for the number of lifeboats.
They did not believe they were in danger.

tables.title: Pronouns (الضمائر)
tables.explanation: ضمائر الفاعل: تأتي قبل الفعل. ضمائر المفعول: تأتي بعد الفعل أو حرف الجر. صفات الملكية: تأتي قبل الاسم. ضمائر الملكية: تحل محل الاسم.
tables.examples:
1502 people had lost their lives.
An unknown person pulled him to be safe.
They had supplied lifeboats for only half the people.

tables.title: Adjectives vs Adverbs (الصفة والظرف)
tables.explanation: الصفة (Adjective): تصف الاسم. تأتي قبل الاسم أو بعد فعل (be). الظرف (Adverb): يصف الفعل. غالباً ينتهي بـ (ly).
tables.examples:
The ship would be completely safe.
Many of them had not even dressed warmly.
Selak was fortunate. (صفة)
He escaped luckily. (ظرف)

tables.title: Pronunciation - /ei/ (الصوت /ei/)
tables.explanation: الصوت /ei/ هو صوت طويل. أمثلة في جمل: I will bake a cake. / Please wait for me. / She has a beautiful gaze. / He hates waiting. / The ship was on its way.
tables.examples: bake, wait, weight, gaze, James, hate, shape, day, sail, wake

tables.title: Word Order (ترتيب الكلمات)
tables.explanation: قاعدة ترتيب الكلمات الأساسية: Subject (فاعل) + Verb (فعل) + Object (مفعول به) + Adverb (ظرف).
tables.examples:
I received an invitation from my uncle.
You will have to write this drill twice.
The teacher gave some good advice to the boy.
